# Shruti 1.4.24 — reliable startup requests
- The Scenes menu now reads saved scene names from local storage as the panel opens, so an audio-service warm-up cannot raise a false unavailable banner. - Safe background lookups retry when Core Audio temporarily occupies the service. A failed lookup no longer marks the live audio connection offline. - Startup pings now honor their fractional-second socket timeout, avoiding an unbounded wait during service recovery. - Dragging the three-line handle on an app row now reorders it directly in Live Now or My Order. Clicking the handle still opens the precise Arrange controls. - The chosen order stays in place through live status refreshes and fast consecutive moves; Shruti confirms the saved order on disk before reporting success.
